notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: There was a bug where if you spoke to Lilith last after a certain mission, it'd say "Time to hit the sack" but the rest option wouldn't trigger. This has been fixed.

Steam Achievements were not working. Fixed now.

notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Full release for the game is finally here.

New scenes, new missions, and of course, the endings.

It's been a long time coming, so thanks for the support.

DLC/Standalone versions are next.

Stay tuned for those!

notes.title: Update v0.2.81
notes.notes:
What's new?

v0.2.8 notes:
-Added 10+ new NSFW scenes
-New missions
-Added special moves for all characters at lvl 10
-Added fast-forward combat option by holding on to the [z] button during battle
-Removed random attacks and added targeted attacks.
-Experience for backstabs added
-New Items: Stim (+100 TP, -100 HP), Cloak (repel random encounters on world map)
-World map encounters increased to ~50 steps per encounter to make optional grinding easier
-Added Steam Achievements
